result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on a potential-type function involving terms τ²/(x+y), τ'²/(x−y) and an integral over s with denominator y²+2xs+s², computing its first and second partial derivatives (second variation in δx, δy) and comparing ∂u/∂x with ∂u/∂y.
result.transcription:
$\frac{4\varepsilon\tau^2}{x+y} + \frac{4\varepsilon\tau'^2}{x-y} - 4\varepsilon' \int \frac{\partial s}{\sqrt{y^2+2xs+s^2}\,(\frac{1}{y^2}+s)}$
$\frac{\tau^2}{x+y} + \frac{\tau'^2}{x-y} - 2u$
$-\frac{\tau^2}{(x+y)^2} - \frac{\tau'^2}{(x-y)^2} - 2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = 0 \qquad \frac{\tau^2}{(x+y)^2} = -\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} \quad (x-y)$
$-\frac{\tau^2}{(x+y)^2} + \frac{\tau'^2}{(x-y)^2} - 2\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 0 \qquad \frac{\tau'^2}{(x-y)^2} = -\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} \quad (x+y)$
$\delta x^2 \left(-2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \frac{2\tau^2}{(x+y)^3} + \frac{2\tau'^2}{(x-y)^3}\right)$
$2\delta x\delta y \left(-2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{2\tau^2}{(x+y)^3} - \frac{2\tau'^2}{(x-y)^3}\right)$
$\delta y^2 \left(-2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} + \frac{2\tau^2}{(x+y)^3} + \frac{2\tau'^2}{(x-y)^3}\right)$
$\delta x^2 \left(-(xx-yy)\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} - 2x\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + 2y\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right)$
$2\delta x\delta y \left(-(xx-yy)\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y} + 2y\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} - 2x\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right)$
$\delta y^2 \left(-(xx-yy)\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} - 2x\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + 2y\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right)$
[-$-\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$-] $= \int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta} \frac{s\,[-(xx-yy)-]}{y^2+2xs+s^2} = $ [-$\int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta} \frac{(x+s)^2}{(y^2+2xs+s^2)}$-] $- s$
[-$yy-xx+s$-] $= (y^2+2xs+s^2) - (x+s)(\frac{y^2}{x}+s)$ [-...-]
$-(xx-yy)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, x - \frac{(y^2+xs)(x+s)}{(y^2+2xs+s^2)} = \int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, x + (\frac{y^2}{s^2}+\frac{2x}{s}+1)^{-\frac12}\, d\frac{x+s}{(\frac{1}{yy}+s)^{\frac12}}$
$\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(1 - \frac12 \frac{(x+s)}{\frac{1}{yy}+s}\right)$
$= \int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(x+1-\frac12 \frac{x+s}{\frac{1}{yy}+s}\right)$
$d\left(\frac{y^2}{s^2}+2\frac{x}{s}+1\right)^{-\frac12} = \left(\frac{y^2}{s^2}+2\frac{x}{s}+1\right)^{-\frac32} \frac{y^2}{s^3}+\frac{x}{s^2}\, \partial s$
$\frac{x+s}{(\frac{1}{yy}+s)^{\frac12}}$
$x>y>1 \quad (\frac{\partial u}{\partial x})^2 \gtrless [?] (\frac{\partial u}{\partial y})^2$
$\delta x^2\left(-\frac{\partial (xx-yy)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}}{\partial x} + 2y\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right) = \int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(1 - \frac12 \frac{1}{\frac{1}{yy}+s} - (x+1-\frac12\frac{x+s}{\frac{1}{yy}+s}) \frac{s}{yy+2xs+s^2}\right) + 2y\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}$
$yy+2xs+s^2 - (\frac{1}{yy}+s)(yy^4 [?]+s) = (2x - \frac{1}{yy} - y^4 [?])\, s$
$1 - (x+1)\frac{s}{(yy+2xs+s^2)} - \frac12 \frac{yy+xs}{(\frac{1}{yy}+s)(yy+2xs+s^2)}$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta} \frac{-y [?]}{(y^2+2xs+s^2)} + \frac{1}{(\frac{1}{y} [?]+yys)\, y}$
